candidates.title: BitPrefill: W1.58A4 Tensor-Core Acceleration for Compute-Bound LLM Prefill
candidates.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces large language model (LLM) inference cost, yet implementations optimized for memory-bound decode can leave compute-bound prefill on BF16 tensor cores. This gap matters for input-heavy workloads, including long-context and multimodal applications, where prefill can account for a substantial fraction of inference latency. We propose a W1.58A4 operator that quantizes weights to ternary values and activations to 4-bit, while executing the linear projection on native INT4 general matrix multiply (GEMM) tensor cores, turning prefill from a full-precision matrix multiply into a low-bit one. We deploy the operator for BitNet-b1.58 on a single RTX 4090 and a Jetson Orin Nano edge device, and report GEMM-kernel latency, end-to-end LLMs prefill latency, and task accuracy against bf16 and BitNet/BitBLAS baselines. Our proposed kernel achieves ~1.42x acceleration compared to the original BF16 prefill phase, with negligible reduction on model accuracy.
candidates.reason: BitPrefillは計算律速なLLMプリフィル向けにW1.58A4量子化演算子をINT4テンソルコアで実行する手法であり、プリフィル高速化への直接貢献が要旨で確認できるため対象とした。

candidates.title: IsoMoE: Placement-Invariant Hybrid CPU-GPU MoE Inference with Lossless 12-bit Experts
candidates.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity at low computational cost. Hybrid CPU-GPU inference offloads some experts to the CPU, enabling a single GPU to run MoE models larger than its memory. Expert placement changes with free GPU memory and should only affect speed. However, the greedy decoding outputs of existing hybrid engines change with placement. This is because the two devices use different arithmetic to compute experts. In addition, decoding is limited by CPU memory bandwidth. Lossless compression reduces memory traffic, but the CPU decompresses entropy-coded formats too slowly to keep up with memory reads. To address these challenges, we propose IsoMoE, an efficient hybrid MoE inference system that guarantees that its outputs do not change with expert placement. IsoMoE introduces (i) a GPU expert kernel that bitwise replays the arithmetic of the CPU expert kernel, (ii) a memory layout that allows the CPU to efficiently compute lossless 12-bit experts using AVX-512 dot-product instructions, and (iii) a dual micro-batch pipeline that overlaps CPU and GPU computation without changing the outputs. Experimental results on three MoE models show that IsoMoE produces bitwise identical outputs across different expert placements. It is also faster than the fastest baseline in every setting, achieving an average decoding speedup of 1.26$\times$ and a maximum speedup of 1.54$\times$. Our source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/isomoe-artifact-9C21/.
candidates.reason: IsoMoEはCPU-GPUハイブリッドMoE推論で配置不変な貪欲デコード出力を保ちながら12ビット専門家の可逆圧縮でCPU帯域律速を緩和する手法であり、MoE推論への直接貢献が要旨で確認できるため対象とした。
